value.rationale: The map trace singles out the lowest recurrence-induced Fourier harmonic without arbitrary parameter slicing. Pairwise-independent observables nevertheless have a completely explicit and nontrivial three-time predictive distribution, and the induced polynomial observable has nonzero universal cubic fluctuation while all pair covariances vanish. These are natural structural questions for deterministic chaos, pseudorandom generators and finite-time departures from Gaussian limits. Exact all-N classification and recurrence uniqueness are more than a routine numerical computation.
